description: This file defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams' within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. The class extends a base FilterParams class and provides functionality to set and get search filter parameters related to interview attachments, specifically focusing on the 'interviewId' property and defining allowed sort fields.

classes.name: InterviewAttachmentSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for filtering search results related to interview attachments, allowing setting and retrieving the interview ID, and defining allowed sort fields.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the filter parameters object and sets default sort field to 'attachment.interviewId'.

methods.name: getInterviewId
methods.description: Returns the interview ID used as a filter parameter.

methods.name: setInterviewId
methods.description: Sets the interview ID filter parameter.
